verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the AudioBufferProcessor, which captures user and bot audio. That is a recording building block a developer could use to construct compliant flows. It is not a documented consent, disclosure, per-call recording-control or data-retention capability. Nothing in the pack covers consent prompts, disclosure handling, toggling recording per call, or configuring how long recordings or transcripts are retained, so the evidence is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention
